summary: SDK-56 retest (post Leaflet-fix) BLOCKED again by a THIRD, separate dangling-import bug. The Leaflet fix in DestinationMapPicker.web.tsx IS confirmed resolved (verified in code, no lazy/Suspense import remains). However, app/women/head-out/circle.tsx and app/women/head-out/destination.tsx both import `useHeadOutWizard` from `@/src/women/headOutWizardStore` — a file that does NOT exist anywhere in the repo (only `src/women/headOutWizardDraft.ts` exists, which radius.tsx correctly uses via loadWizardDraft/saveWizardDraft instead of a hook). Because expo-router's `app (require.context)` eagerly scans every file under app/ to build its route manifest, this single unresolvable import breaks Metro's bundling for the ENTIRE app, not just the Head Out wizard screens. On first page load the app initially rendered (stale Metro cache: language screen, consent screen reachable), but on every subsequent fresh reload the app now consistently shows a full-screen Resolution Error ('Unable to resolve module @/src/women/headOutWizardStore') and nothing else renders. This is a full outage, not limited to the wizard flow. Per the decision framework (Metro bundler crash / red screen error), testing was stopped and this is reported immediately rather than attempting further flows.

react_native_issues.issue: Both import `useHeadOutWizard` from '@/src/women/headOutWizardStore', a file that does not exist anywhere in the repo. Only src/women/headOutWizardDraft.ts exists (plain AsyncStorage get/set functions, no hook/store export), which is what radius.tsx correctly uses instead. This is a THIRD piece of incomplete/pasted code (same pattern as the earlier Leaflet dangling import) and currently breaks Metro's bundling of the entire app via expo-router's require.context route-manifest scan — every fresh page load now shows a full-screen 'Resolution Error' overlay with zero functional UI, not just the head-out wizard.

rca_of_issue: Root cause: app/women/head-out/circle.tsx (line 28) and app/women/head-out/destination.tsx (line 34) import `{ useHeadOutWizard }` from '@/src/women/headOutWizardStore', a module that was never created in this repo. The only related file, src/women/headOutWizardDraft.ts, exports plain async functions (loadWizardDraft/saveWizardDraft/clearWizardDraft), not a hook — and is the mechanism radius.tsx actually uses. Reproduction: fresh browser load of http://localhost:3000 (not a stale/cached tab) immediately shows Metro's red 'Resolution Error' overlay citing 'Unable to resolve module @/src/women/headOutWizardStore', because expo-router's require.context for route registration eagerly imports every file under app/, so one broken import anywhere under app/ fails the whole bundle, not just that screen.
